title: New Version Available - CVToolkit v10.0
description: A focused design refresh: every one of the 139 screens has been redesigned around a new diagnostic-tool brand identity, with a custom SignalCyan / TerminalGreen palette, monospaced numerics, denser outlined cards and terminal-style section headers. Includes a long-standing Speed Test fix so custom test targets now persist across sessions.
changelog: Redesigned all 139 screens with a custom diagnostic-tool brand identity
New SignalCyan primary + TerminalGreen secondary + Amber tertiary palette
Tightened M3 type scale with dedicated MonoText styles for numerics (IPs, hashes, latency, byte counts)
Tighter shapes (6 / 10 / 14 / 18 / 24 dp) wired through MaterialTheme.shapes
Edge-to-edge layout with auto status/nav-bar icon contrast
Redesigned Home screen: brand top bar with mono tagline, outlined card grid, scrollable pill tabs with mono counts, terminal-style section headers
New reusable component library: SectionHeader, FlagSectionHeader, StatusBadge, StatTile, ToolScaffold, MonoTag, plus a latencyColor(ms) helper
Polished Settings screen: section headers, outlined row cards with tinted icon containers, mono English-name subtitle
Polished Update dialog: monospaced version + filesize, primary-tinted version label
Speed Test bug fix: custom targets added via the + button now persist across navigation and app restart (SharedPreferences + Gson)
Custom Speed Test targets gain a trash-icon delete action in the dropdown; built-in targets stay protected
Dynamic color (Material You) is now opt-in so the brand identity stays consistent across devices
Replaced deprecated Window.statusBarColor / navigationBarColor calls with enableEdgeToEdge() + WindowInsetsControllerCompat
